sources.entry: Choosy - UI, URL API and a browser extension set for managing rules where and how to open links.

summary.name: Choosy
summary.one_liner: Choosy is a macOS app that intercepts links and sends each one to a chosen browser, based on prompts or user-defined rules.
use_cases: Choose which browser opens each link
Route email links to Safari automatically
Open links in a specific Chrome or Edge profile
Move a web page to another browser
summary.what_it_does: Choosy replaces the default browser on a Mac and sends each link to a browser of the user's choice. It can prompt the user to pick from installed browsers or only running ones. Behaviour rules can route links automatically without a prompt, such as always opening links from a given email client in Safari. It can select specific profiles or private windows in Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave and Vivaldi. It also includes browser extensions for moving a page between browsers and a URL-based API usable from Terminal, AppleScript, or any URL opener.
notable: Per-link browser picker with rules for automatic routing
Selects Chrome, Edge, Brave and Vivaldi profiles or private windows
URL-based API for scripts and automation
Browser extensions to move pages between browsers
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page text provided
Works only on macOS as described on the page
